title: cyperus haspan var. cancellatus
intro: Cyperus haspan var. cancellatus, commonly known as the desert papyrus, is a type of sedge plant native to Africa and parts of the Middle East. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and treating various health conditions. The desert papyrus is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Cyperus haspan var. cancellatus include reducing fever, alleviating digestive issues, and supporting immune function.
